title: What Our
para: A trusted community of verified homeowners and passionate travelers.

testimonialFirstCard.description: Traveling with kids means we need space and a kitchen, which hotels rarely offer without a crazy price tag. Vacanza let us exchange our flat in Athens with a family in Crete. We had everything we needed.This platform really understands families

testimonialSecondCard.description: Cool website! Being a student I am on a budget, and I love this platform because it allows me to travel in Greece for free basically

testimonialThirdCard.description: As a remote worker living in Greece, I’ve always wanted to move around more...with Vacanza it became so affordable! Now I can work from different cities, while making new friendships and experiences
